output.title: New opt-in annotation-copy flag; no Ingress/Gateway usage shown
output.content: The release note describes a new controller option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, that lets you choose annotation keys to copy from an Ingress or Gateway to the Certificate it produces. It is presented as an option you can add, not as a change to existing behaviour. None of the 9 values keys shown here configure it. The manifests list only Namespace, Deployment, Argo CD Application, cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and Flux HelmRelease, with no Ingress or Gateway resources. The values dimension is only partial, so check that no controller args are set elsewhere, and consider this flag if you want Ingress- or Gateway-generated Certificates to carry those annotations.
